title: Developmental xenocortication using human-derived organoids in mice.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Found GEO GSE301194 (single-cell RNA sequencing, 8 samples) by searching GEO, since the paper has no PMC full text or NCBI links. Read the file list: 6 human-organoid graft samples (10x-style MTX/barcodes/features, ~80-105 MB matrices each), 2 whole-brain apallial (cortex-depleted) control mice (Parse-style MTX of 3.4 GB and 1.8 GB), two processed Seurat objects (an R single-cell data format) of 4.4 GB and 7.6 GB, and a 5.3 GB RAW tar. Downloaded and counted barcodes: 11,604 / 10,678 / 11,644 / 8,585 / 12,664 / 10,225 cells (65,400 in total). The features file has 68,886 rows: 36,601 human GRCh38 and 32,285 mouse mm10 genes (a mixed-species reference). Opened the female control metadata CSV: 647,200 cells, with columns for sample, species, gene/transcript counts and barcode wells, but no cell-type column.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Abstract only (paywalled, no PMC copy): graft volume, cell-type diversity, calcium imaging, electrophysiology and behaviour. I found no deposited calcium-imaging, electrophysiology or behaviour tables. The 91.9% graft-volume figure comes from press coverage, not from files. Cell-type annotations are presumably inside the Seurat RDS files, which I did not open because they are over the 50 MB cap.

a1_downloadable.note: GEO GSE301194 is public, no login needed. Checked the file list and downloaded the barcode, feature and metadata files.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: The open MTX and metadata files have no outcome column, only sample, line, day and QC counts (checked in files). Cell-type labels, if present, sit only in the 4.4-7.6 GB Seurat objects, and the behaviour and imaging readouts are not deposited, so any prediction target would have to be constructed.

a3_inputs_present.note: Gene-by-cell count matrices are present, with Ensembl gene IDs in the features files (checked).

a4_units_stated.note: Raw UMI (unique molecular identifier) counts, the standard single-cell unit; units are implicit in the format.

a5_enough_rows.note: 65,400 graft cells counted from the barcodes, but they come from only 6 grafts, 2 stem-cell lines and 2 time points (checked in sample titles). Any biological contrast has n = 6 units, not 65,400.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: ~560 MB of compressed graft matrices; control mouse matrices are 5.1 GB
a6_fits_laptop.note: The graft matrices fit in RAM; the control mice and Seurat objects would need subsetting.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No cell counts were available from the paper text (abstract only) to compare, so this is unverified rather than contradicted.

a8_label_provenance.note: The only label obtainable at scale is cell-type identity, which authors assign by clustering the same expression features. Predicting it from expression is circular (the label is computed from the features).

backbone.name: Geneformer or scGPT (single-cell foundation models) would match the data type

integration.partner_dataset: Developing human cortex atlases (e.g. primary fetal cortex single-cell data) via Ensembl gene IDs
integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: How closely do human organoid cells matured in a mouse cortex match primary human fetal cortex? That is an atlas-mapping analysis, not a supervised prediction task.

honest_claim_h3: At best, a classifier would recover author-assigned clusters among 65,400 cells from 6 grafts derived from 2 stem-cell lines; that's circular and has no measured outcome.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use single-cell gene expression from human organoid grafts in mice to predict cell identity or graft condition.
plain_idea.train_on: Gene-expression profiles of 65,400 single human cells (verified barcode count) from 6 grafts in cortex-depleted mice.
plain_idea.predict: Cell type, which the authors assign by clustering the same expression data, or graft line/time point (6 units). Neither is an independent measurement.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Little. The data suit atlas comparison of grafted versus primary human cortex, not supervised ML. The behaviour and calcium-imaging readouts that would make a real label are not deposited.

ml_idea: None viable. Cell-type annotation from expression is circular (A8), the true experimental unit is 6 grafts (A5), and the functional and behavioural readouts are not in any deposited file (A2).

effort.compute_note: Only file sizes were measured; no timing was done because the project was rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count independent units: 6 grafts from 2 lines (done, from the GEO sample titles).

verdict_reason: GEO GSE301194 holds only single-cell count matrices: 65,400 graft cells from 6 grafts and 2 stem-cell lines. There is no measured outcome column, cell-type labels would be circular because they come from clustering the same expression, and the behaviour and imaging data are not deposited.
